sloka: कृत कृत्या हि वैदेही चाया इव अनुगता पतिम् ।न जहाति रता धर्मे मेरुम् अर्क प्रभा यथा ॥२-४०-२४॥
transliteration: kṛta kṛtyā hi vaidehī cāyā iva anugatā patim ।na jahāti ratā dharme merum arka prabhā yathā ॥2-40-24॥

translations.english: Sita, deeply attached to her duty, and with her desire fulfilled is following her husband like a shadow just as the sunlight which never leaves mount Meru.
